ENTRY OF JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION, DEFENDANT, TERRY PETTY DEFAULTED AS OF 10-19-94. HIS DEFAULT IS MERGED WITH THIS JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF, BOB WOODCOCK, IS TO HAVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF 834 CAPP STREET, SAN FRANCISCO AS TO RICHARD VITALE ONLY PLAINTIFF, BOB WOODCOCK, SHALL RECEIVE BACK RENT OF $1400 TO BE PAID AT THE RATE OF 100 EACH MONTH BEGINNING 12-15-94. A WRIT MAY ISSUE IMMEDIATELY AND THE SHERIFF MAY POST. ACTUAL PHYSICAL EVICTION SHALL BE STAYED UNTIL 11-14-94. EACH SIDE SHALL BEAR THEIR OWN COSTS. THERE WILL BE NO FURTHER STAYS OF EXECUTION. THERE AREN'T ANY OTHER ADULTS LIVING AT 834 CAPP STREET, SAN FRANCISCO. THERE WILL BE A MUTUAL RELEASE OF ALL CLAIMS. DEFENDANT RICHARD VITALE FORFEITS ANY INTEREST IN THE LEASE. THE SECURITY DEPOSITE AND LAST MONTHS RENT MAY BE KEPT BY THE PLAINTIFF. EXECUTION ON THE MONEY JUDGMENT WILL NTO TAKE PLACE IF PAYMENTS ARE MAINTAINED. EXECUTION ON THE MONEY JUDGMENT WILL NOT TAKE PLACE IF PAYMENTS ARE MAINTAINED.
